newsitem.title: HONG KONG: RESEARCH ALERT - Zhenhai Refining downgrade.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Zhenhai Refining downgrade.

text.p: Merrill Lynch has lowered its opinion on Zhenhai Refining & Chemical Ltd from a buy to neutral, the brokerage said in its September review of Asia-Pacific (Ex-Japan) Chemicals.
The report said that the share price of the mainland China refiner had gained 67 percent in the year to September 6, outperforming the Hang Seng Index.
Zhenhai Refining has been the best performing H share in 1996, the report said.
Merrill Lynch analyst Janet Yang said that the stock had sound fundamentals but was not expected to continue to outperform the index.
